expected_findings.root_cause: regression() compares delta against +max_drop instead of -max_drop, so the sign of the check is wrong
expected_findings.failure_path: with max_drop=0.03 the check `delta < 0.03` is true for every regression and also for every neutral or small positive delta; a candidate that improves hit@5 by 0.02 fails CI, and the flag no longer expresses 'more than this drop'
